creative_thesis.thesis_statement: Scientific authority becomes compelling when the environment behaves as a living system being interpreted by the expert, not as a forest backdrop or literal laboratory.
creative_thesis.communication_problem: Communicate science, nature and discovery while distinguishing an environmental expert from generic wilderness and textbook imagery.
creative_thesis.creative_answer: Integrate the biologist into layered ecological relationships where patterns, specimens and environmental signals reveal intelligence across scales.
creative_thesis.desired_viewer_perception: This expert can read the hidden organization of living systems and turn observation into insight.
creative_thesis.rationale: Nature becomes evidence and narrative when its layers relate causally, rather than serving as wallpaper.

commercial_psychology.rationale: Discovery attracts attention; observable systems make that discovery credible.

narrative_tension.central_tension: Human scientific interpretation versus the complexity of a living ecosystem.
narrative_tension.subject_role: Interpreter of patterns that are present but not immediately visible.
narrative_tension.environment_role: An active network of ecological evidence across multiple scales.
narrative_tension.relationship: The expert is embedded in and visually connected to the system being interpreted.
narrative_tension.rationale: The environment tells a story of relationships, not just biodiversity abundance.

subject_strategy.presence: Clear authority without heroic explorer posing
subject_strategy.relationship_to_environment: Ecological layers cross around the subject and align with the act of observation
subject_strategy.relationship_to_viewer: Invites the viewer to see the system through expert attention
identity_requirements: Avoid costume stereotypes and exaggerated adventure styling

emotional_strategy.rationale: Wonder should emerge from coherent ecological evidence.

visual_hierarchy.reason: Human interpretation is the value proposition.

visual_hierarchy.relationship_to_previous: Clarifies the meaning of the system.

creative_concept.visual_world: A layered environmental field where macro habitat, organism traces and fine biological structures remain spatially connected.
creative_concept.narrative_function: Make scientific insight visible as the discovery of relationships.
creative_concept.composition_logic: The expert anchors a chain of attention connecting ecological signals across the frame.
creative_concept.depth_logic: Foreground biodiversity traces, subject plane and environmental systems form distinct but connected layers.
creative_concept.environment_logic: Each natural element contributes evidence, scale transition or directional continuity.
creative_concept.typography_role: Copy occupies a calm observation field and does not compete with ecological detail.

candidates.concept_summary: The expert reveals ecological relationships across nested scales.
candidates.core_mechanism: Connected scale transitions through layered environmental evidence
risks: Too many layers can lose hierarchy
candidates.decision_reason: Every visual layer can serve observation, relationship or discovery.

candidates.concept_summary: Portrait of the biologist in lush vegetation.
candidates.decision_reason: A forest locates the subject but does not communicate expertise.

candidates.concept_summary: Expert surrounded by microscopes, glassware and diagrams.
candidates.decision_reason: Prop shorthand replaces integrated environmental science.

ideation.convergence_summary: The selected route treats biodiversity as a connected information system rather than scenery or laboratory inventory.

selected_direction.name: Reading the Living System
selected_direction.concept: The environmental expert interprets a layered ecosystem whose signals connect habitat, organisms and fine structure.
selected_direction.why_it_won: It makes science and nature inseparable while giving each element narrative function.
selected_direction.core_visual_idea: Discovery travels through connected ecological scales around the expert.
selected_direction.creative_risk: Biodiversity density can become collage or wallpaper.
selected_direction.originality_strategy: Use causal ecological relationships and scale transitions instead of generic foliage or laboratory symbols.

visual_mechanisms.name: ECOLOGICAL_SCALE_CHAIN
visual_mechanisms.function: Connect habitat, organism evidence and microstructure in a readable sequence.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Makes biodiversity a story of relationships.

visual_mechanisms.name: BIODIVERSITY_LAYERED_DEPTH
visual_mechanisms.function: Distribute ecological evidence across real spatial layers.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Prevents nature wallpaper and flat montage.

visual_mechanisms.name: OBSERVATION_LED_ATTENTION
visual_mechanisms.function: Use the expert's attention to initiate the ecological reading path.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: The expert must interpret the system, not merely stand inside it.

queries: science nature integration without laboratory cliché

retrieved_mechanisms.how_adapted: Every layer must supply environmental evidence and connect spatially.

selected_mechanisms.how_adapted: Converted into the ecological scale chain.

rejected_mechanisms.rejection_reason: Would risk decorative pseudo-science and generator-like UI clutter.

adaptation_notes: No scientific claims are invented; mechanisms organize brief-supported perception only.

evidence.approved_pattern: The approved environmental hero used layered biodiversity and connected environmental signals; generic forest portrait and literal lab staging were rejected.
evidence.relevance_to_current_problem: The same science-nature integration problem is present.
evidence.how_it_influenced_direction: Required ecology to function as a connected spatial system around the expert.

protected_elements.description: Science and nature must be integrated, not shown as separate icon sets.

creative_constraints.statement: Every environmental element must serve evidence, scale, depth, attention or narrative.
Do not imply unsupported scientific findings or measurements.
creative_constraints.rationale: Scientific authority cannot rest on invented evidence.

banned_tropes.name: GENERIC_JUNGLE_WALLPAPER
banned_tropes.description: Lush forest used as undifferentiated background.
banned_tropes.reason: Nature has no storytelling or scientific function.

banned_tropes.name: LITERAL_LABORATORY
banned_tropes.description: Microscope and glassware staging used as the main science signal.
banned_tropes.reason: Creates textbook shorthand and separates science from environment.

frozen_decisions.decision: Expert interprets a connected living system across scales.
Ecological layers must have narrative and spatial function.

strong_guidelines.decision: Detail must remain subordinate to expert-led reading.

open_decisions.decision: Exact organisms, environmental forms, lens and lighting behavior.
open_decisions.rationale: Technical choices may vary if scientifically responsible and conceptually functional.

confidence.rationale: The direction makes science, environment and discovery mutually reinforcing.

technical_handoff.creative_goal: Show the biologist as the interpreter of a living environmental system.
technical_handoff.selected_direction_summary: Expert-led attention reveals connected ecological evidence across layered scales.
known_risks: Science cues can become decorative pseudo-data
